name: card-skill
title_zh: 把文字与论据渲染成统一风格的分享级卡片图
tagline_zh: 笔记、引文、论点、仓库说明——一句话就要变信息图？不用挑模板、调字体，它用同一套 Kenny 视觉语法直接出片。
tagline_en: Turn notes, quotes, arguments, or repo blurbs into polished infographic cards—one consistent Kenny-style grammar.
desc_en: Render text and evidence into polished, shareable PNG visuals with one consistent Kenny Style visual grammar. Use this skill whenever the user asks to turn words, notes, articles, quotes, arguments, stories, open-source repository or tool material, technical commands/workflows, explicit WeChat Reading highlights/thoughts, or WeChat Reading personal statistics into an 信息图/infographic, 海报/poster, 卡片
why_zh: 不是又一个拼模板工具，而是把「视觉语法」固化成规则：标题层级、证据标注、留白节奏全自动统一。
why_en: Not another template picker—it codifies a visual grammar into rules: heading hierarchy, evidence callouts, whitespace rhythm all.
limit_zh: 只认文本与结构化证据（引文/数据/列表），不处理任意图片合成；产物是 PNG 卡片而非可编辑源文件。
limit_en: Text & structured evidence only—no arbitrary image compositing. Outputs PNG cards, not editable sources. Tables or code blocks >20 lines get.
title_en: Render text & evidence into share-ready cards in one.
